title: Opposite self-square exchange on a specified coefficient line
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring, $Y$ a scheme, $P=\mathbf P^1_Y$, $W=P\times_Y P$, and $q:P\to Y$, $p_i:W\to P$ the projections [def-sfb-projective-diagonal-pullback]. For $T\in D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_P})$, $N\in D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_W})$ and a specified isomorphism $e:p_2^*T\simeq N$, define $b_T:q^*Rq_*T\to Rp_{1*}N$ as the mate of the inverse canonical pullback square comparison followed by $Rp_{1*}(e)$. All functors and adjunctions are the native derived module functors; no invertibility of this mate is assumed.
